Occupational health and safety experience conducting safe patient handling risk assessments, product evaluations, and/or injury prevention program development, implementation, and training in a hospital based setting
Experience in adult education

The Health System Safe Patient Handling (SPH) Training Coordinator is responsible for assisting in oversight of Safe Patient Handling (SPH) programs as assigned. Responsibilities include: developing, coordinating and training staff, implementation of SPH strategies, regular rounding of clinical areas and availability to patient care areas to provide coaching and continually foster a "safe patient handling" environment; implement unit level SPH peer champions; evaluate ways to reduce risks associated with patient handling, including evaluation of equipment and the environment, review of accident and injury reports; tracking advances in SPH technology and making recommendations for UCI Health System; track SPH legislation and insure Health System compliance; collaborating with other UC campuses to contribute to a coordinated SPH program UC-wide.
Works collaboratively with various stakeholders: Nursing department, Rehab, Lift Team, and other departments with patient handling responsibilities.
Must demonstrate strong organization skills and problem solving skills
Must demonstrate customer service skills appropriate to the job
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Ability to maintain a work pace appropriate to the workload
Ability to communicate in person, with a wide range of people in an effective professional manner
